Start is approximated to 2018, the earliest sourced ABRACADABRA run at MIT (see experiment:abracadabra intervals), used as a conservative lower bound for this open-ended 'active' interval, not a claimed founding date.
intervals.quote: we present the first results from a 1 month search for axions with ABRACADABRA-10 cm

name: Massachusetts Institute of Technology
notes: This record describes MIT in its role as a physics-experiment host; the university itself is recorded separately as institution:massachusetts-institute-of-technology.

summary.plain: MIT (Massachusetts Institute of Technology) is a university in Cambridge, Massachusetts. Its physics department built ABRACADABRA, a small experiment that searched for the axion, a hypothetical dark-matter particle.
summary.technical: MIT Laboratory for Nuclear Science / Department of Physics (Cambridge, MA), host institution of the Winslow group's ABRACADABRA-10 cm and successor lumped-element axion dark-matter searches.
